repo_contract.delivery_path: branch -> pull request -> CI checks -> reviewed merge -> deploy

product.name: Lama Dev School Management Dashboard
product.primary_problem: Provide role-appropriate school operations, schedule, attendance, result, event, and announcement workflows from one dashboard.
critical_user_journeys: Administrator manages school structure and people records.
Teacher manages lessons, assignments, exams, attendance, and results.
Student views class schedule, assignments, exams, results, and attendance.
Parent views child-specific schedule, announcements, events, attendance, and results.

architecture.summary: Next.js App Router dashboard with Clerk-authenticated role surfaces, Prisma as the data access layer, and PostgreSQL as the system of record.
runtime_topology: Next.js application server renders role-specific dashboard routes and serves the dependency-light /health endpoint.
Clerk provides authentication and role metadata used by middleware and server components.
Prisma Client mediates application access to PostgreSQL.
Container builds generate Prisma Client and the Next.js production build without running database migrations.

critical_boundaries.auth: Role and identity decisions stay in Clerk middleware, Clerk helpers, and role-aware server components.
critical_boundaries.data: School records are persisted through Prisma models backed by PostgreSQL; avoid ad hoc database access paths.
critical_boundaries.deployment: Image build, migration deploy, app start, and health smoke are separate release steps.
critical_boundaries.secrets: Secrets come from process environment or the deployment platform and must not be committed.

release_risk_surfaces: Clerk auth, middleware matchers, and role routing.
Prisma schema, migrations, seed data, and database connection settings.
Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, CI workflow, and deployment environment variables.
Dashboard pages that expose student, parent, teacher, or administrator data.
architecture.decision_policy: Prefer small, reversible changes that preserve role-specific dashboard behavior. Require explicit design notes, verification evidence, and rollback notes for auth, Prisma, middleware, Docker, CI, or deployment changes.

agile.planning_cadence: Small, reviewable pull requests. Major feature work starts with PRFAQ/problem framing and critical user journey mapping before implementation.
agile.backlog_policy: Prioritize work that reduces release risk, protects role-based school workflows, or improves evidence for production decisions.
definition_of_ready: Target user, user problem, and success metric are named.
Primary critical user journey and failure-sensitive points are documented.
Affected routes, Prisma models, auth roles, deploy surfaces, and rollback path are identified.
Required verification commands are selected from verification_contract.json.
definition_of_done: Behavior changes are covered by focused tests or documented as intentionally unchanged.
npm run verify passes, or blockers and residual risk are recorded in .codex/reports/release-readiness.md.
Deploy-facing changes include /health smoke evidence and rollback notes.
PR description links the product brief or journey update when the change is feature-facing.

release_planning.default_path: branch -> pull request -> CI checks -> reviewed merge -> deploy
release_planning.deployment_policy: No production deploy from an AI session; release owner approves promotion after evidence review.
release_planning.rollback_policy: Prefer PR revert or previous_release redeploy. Schema changes must use backward-compatible expand/contract steps until restore is tested.

agile.retro_policy: Capture reusable release lessons in AGENTS.md, .codex rules, docs/operations, or the release-readiness report before closing major nodes.

deploy_contract.runtime_artifact: Next.js production build or container image after verification
deploy_contract.env_file_source: process environment supplied by deployment platform; committed .env files are forbidden

required_gates: python syntax gate when Python files exist
npx prisma migrate deploy against disposable database
health smoke against started production build
known_blockers: No browser end-to-end suite exists for authenticated dashboard flows.
The critical production dependency audit is a required gate; remaining non-critical production advisories require separate behavior-tested dependency work.
Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml are hardened as a local release evidence path, but Docker Compose is not confirmed as the production deployment interface.
Production secrets, service manager, target metadata, and deployment credentials are not available in this workspace.
